title: 第6072章 序列之子第6071章 人不为己天诛地灭
lines: 叶寒听完之后，深吸一口气，陷入沉默。
许久，都说不出话来。
“也便是说，天道榜，就如同是一座牢笼！”
“这座牢笼出现，网罗这第七层诸天的各种妖孽、异数，以供那些参加天禁神殿禁忌试炼的生灵降临下来夺舍？”
“不过，第八层诸天的修行体系，必然不是这第七层诸天所能相比较的，纵然是肉身与神魂出问题，想要恢复，不是很难吧？”
叶寒再度好奇道。
堕落王神摇了摇头：“你不懂葬神之地的可怕，正常来说，就算我身为终焉之主，一旦进入葬神之地，最终活着出来的可能性，恐怕也就一成，最多两成而已，即便活着出来，肉身肯定已经腐坏。”
顿了顿，堕落王神继续道：“在葬神之地，一旦肉身或是神魂腐坏，基本上是不可逆的，也便是几乎不可能借助任何的天地至宝而恢复，那最好的方式，便是降临这第七层诸天，选择一尊肉身强大、神魂强大的生灵，进行夺舍，取而代之，一旦夺舍成功，那便等同于抛掉了一切的负面影响。”
“明白了！”
叶寒点头回应着。
脑海中，便出现了两个字：墟界。
昔日被君家君龙象始祖所炼化的墟界，包括自己体内的归墟之界，或许，便是和堕落王神口中那葬神之地差不多的世界。
当然了，葬神之地，在本质上肯定要比墟界，包括比自己的归墟之界更加强大无数倍，也恐怖无数倍。
其中的阴暗气息、阴暗力量、阴暗物质，亦是可怕了无数倍。
这样推演下来……
如果真的能够通过那所谓的试炼，能够从那葬神之地活着出来，那尊生灵的天赋……
的确堪称变态。
甚至，抛开天赋和战力底蕴，还需要有足够强大的气运，才能够活着出来。
如果气运不够的话，也是必死无疑。
不过……
就在这一刹那，叶寒心灵深处，倒是莫名涌现出了一股冲动。
他倒是想要进入葬神之地看一看。
如果真的进入那葬神之地，是否有机会，让自己的归墟之界产生无上的蜕变？
毕竟是同种同源，极其类似的两个世界。
能否将葬神之地的各种阴暗气息、力量、物质给吸收过来，融入归墟之界里面？
但可惜，那是第八层诸天的世界。
根本不可能有什么机会进入其中。
更何况，自己即便能够偷渡到第八层诸天之中，和当初前来第七层诸天一样，也改名换姓，改变身份，先不说那样实在是太过危险，而且前去参加所谓的禁忌试炼，也没什么机会了。
很明显，现在的情况是，这一次的禁忌试炼已经临近末期。
就在这时。
堕落王神继续道：“至于你刚刚所说的赵公子，呵呵……。”
“怎么了？”
叶寒好奇道。
“他也算不得什么序列之子，或者说，不配成为序列之子。”
堕落王神道：“顶多是半步序列之子罢了，多半是未曾通过试炼，不过倒是踏上了禁忌天梯，通过禁忌天梯提前离开试炼之地。”
content_en:
"This?"
After hearing this, Ye Han took a deep breath and fell into silence.
For a long time, I was speechless.
"In other words, the Tiandao Ranking is like a cage!"
"This cage appears to trap all kinds of monsters and anomalies in the seventh layer of heaven, so that those creatures who participate in the forbidden trials of the Forbidden Temple can come down and seize their bodies?"
"However, the cultivation system of the eighth-level heavens is definitely not comparable to that of the seventh-level heavens. Even if there is a problem with the physical body or the soul, it will not be difficult to recover, right?"
Ye Han was curious again.
"Difficult!"
The Fallen King God shook his head: "You don't understand the horror of the God Burial Land. Normally, even if I am the Lord of the End, once I enter the God Burial Land, the possibility of finally coming out alive is probably only 10%, or at most 20%. Even if I come out alive, my body must have been corrupted."
After a pause, the Fallen King God continued: "In the God Burial Ground, once the body or soul is corrupted, it is basically irreversible, that is, it is almost impossible to recover with the help of any heaven and earth treasures. The best way is to descend to the seventh level of the heavens and choose a creature with a strong body and a powerful soul to seize the body and replace it. Once the body is successfully taken, it is equivalent to throwing away all negative effects."
"Got it!"
Ye Han nodded in response.
Two words appeared in my mind: Ruin Realm.
The Xu Realm that was refined by the ancestor of the Jun family, Long Xiang, including the Gui Xu Realm in his own body, may be a world similar to the God Burial Ground mentioned by the Fallen King God.
Of course, the God Burial Land is definitely countless times more powerful and terrifying than the Ruins Realm, including the Ruins Realm itself.
The dark atmosphere, dark power, and dark matter in it are also countless times more terrifying.
Deduced like this...
If you can really pass the so-called trial and come out alive from the place where gods are buried, then the talent of that creature...
It's indeed a perversion.
Even aside from talent and combat power, one still needs strong enough luck to survive.
If you don't have enough luck, you will definitely die.
But...
At this moment, deep in Ye Han's heart, an impulse emerged inexplicably.
He actually wanted to enter the God Burial Ground to take a look.
If you really enter the place where the gods are buried, will you have the opportunity to undergo a supreme transformation in your realm of ruins?
After all, they are two very similar worlds with the same origin.
Can the various dark atmospheres, powers, and materials from the God Burial Land be absorbed and integrated into the Realm of Guixu?
But unfortunately, that is the world of the eighth heaven.
There is no chance of getting into it.
What's more, even if I could sneak into the eighth heaven and change my name and identity just like I did when I came to the seventh heaven, not to mention that it would be too dangerous, and there would be no chance of participating in the so-called taboo trial.
It is obvious that the current situation is that this taboo trial is approaching its end.
Just then.
The Fallen King God continued: "As for Mr. Zhao you just mentioned, haha..."
"What's wrong?"
Ye Han asked curiously.
"He is not a son of the sequence, or in other words, he is not worthy of being a son of the sequence."
The Fallen King said: "At most, he is the son of a half-step sequence. Most of them have not passed the trial, but they have stepped onto the forbidden ladder and left the trial place early through the forbidden ladder."
title_en: Chapter 6072: Son of Sequence Chapter 6071: People who don’t do it for themselves will be destroyed by heaven and earth
